lines: +"""Compatibility shims restoring harbor-miles-v0.20.0 behaviour on upstream Harbor.
+Loaded by Harbor through import paths that ``harbor_agent_function`` puts in the
+every trial). This module lives on the rollout worker's PYTHONPATH next to the
+agent function; the installed Harbor package is not modified.
+Restored behaviour, keyed to why the old branch carried it:
+* A reply truncated at the per-turn token cap (``finish_reason == "length"``)
+  aborts the trial (``SingleTurnMaxSeqLenExceededError``). Upstream salvages a
+  clean prefix and/or re-queries with the truncated text re-sent as a fabricated
+  assistant turn, which desyncs the TITO session server: the tokens it trained
+  on would be ones the policy never produced in that context.
+* A sequence that grows past ``max_seq_len`` aborts the trial
+  (``MaxSeqLenExceededError``) once the response that crossed the cap comes
+  back, before any of that response's commands run.
+* Verifier reward files parse the way they used to: numeric strings in
+  ``reward.json`` coerce to numbers, and non-finite values reach the agent
+  function (whose non-finite-selected-reward rule turns the episode into an
+  infra failure) instead of being rejected verifier-side, which would also
+  have rejected episodes whose *selected* reward is finite but which carry a
+  non-finite auxiliary metric, and episodes with numeric-string rewards.
+so terminus-2's retry/summarize wiring treats them the way the old branch did
+with summarization off (the training recipe): no retry, no re-query. Their
